BAJFINANCE.attchmntText: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 5,74,25,740 securities pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on November 10, 2026
BAJFINANCE.voiceSummary: Bajaj Finance Limited has approved the preferential allotment of 5,74,25,740 warrants to its holding company, Bajaj Finserv Limited. The allotment was approved by the PI 2026 Allotment Committee on 10 November 2026. Each warrant is priced at Rs. 1,010 and is convertible into one equity share of face value Re. 1. The warrants are convertible into equity shares pari passu with existing fully paid-up shares. Upon issuance, a minimum of 25 percent of the consideration is payable on the date of allotment. If the allottee does not exercise the option within eighteen months from the date of allotment, the consideration amount shall be forfeited by the company.

Suzuki Motor Corporation reported consolidated revenue of 1,466.5 billion yen for the period, an increase of 16.8 percent year-on-year. Operating profit was 134.3 billion yen, a decrease of 0.6 percent. Profit before tax stood at 156.5 billion yen, down 24.5 percent. HCLTECH.voiceSummary: HCL Technologies Ltd. has announced a collaboration with PTC to accelerate semiconductor product lifecycle management. The partnership involves launching a pre-configured semiconductor Product Lifecycle Management solution built on the PTC Windchill platform. This solution aims to streamline product development, strengthen quality and compliance, and reduce operational complexity. It connects people, processes, and data across the semiconductor lifecycle, including IP management, new product introduction, supplier collaboration, and regulatory compliance. The solution integrates with existing business, manufacturing, and design systems for end-to-end visibility. HCLTech and PTC stated that the collaboration helps customers modernize product development and management at scale. The announcement was filed with the BSE and NSE on November 10, 2026.

JUBLPHARMA.voiceSummary: Jubilant Pharmova submitted a press release regarding its subsidiary, Jubilant Therapeutics. STYLAMIND.attchmntText: Stylam Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of Investor and Analyst Meet.
STYLAMIND.voiceSummary: Stylam Industries Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call with BSE and NSE. The call was held on November 04, 2026. The company reported expected turnover of INR250 crores to INR300 crores from its new plant this year. Export realization per kg increased to INR191 in Q2 from INR161 in the previous year. EBITDA margin stood at 18 point something percent. Management cited war-related ocean freight issues and rising crude prices as reasons for margin pressure. The new plant is becoming fully operational within the month. Domestic market revamping is expected to show results in the next two quarters. Export growth is driven by global manufacturing challenges in Europe. Other expenses increased due to energy and freight costs.

WEBELSOLAR.attchmntText: Websol Energy System Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
WEBELSOLAR.voiceSummary: Websol Energy System Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings call held on 5th November 2026. The company reported half-year revenue of INR 734 crores and net profit of INR 80 crores for the period ended 30th September 2026. Websol became debt-free in August 2026 after repaying IREDA debt. Solar cell utilization stood at 91 percent, with module utilization at 68 percent. The order book reached INR 1,280 crores. The Board approved a 4 gigawatt integrated facility in West Bengal on 54.20 acres, planned in two phases. Phase one costs INR 1,350 crores. The company is converting its MonoPERC line to TOPCon technology. The Board also approved entering EPC, independent power production, and energy trading sectors. It approved subscribing to 40 percent of Bright Earth Cell Private Limited for energy trading. Vinay was appointed CEO of Websol Renewables. Trial runs for the new facility are targeted for the third quarter of the next financial year.

EMIL.attchmntText: Electronics Mart India Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
EMIL.voiceSummary: Electronics Mart India Limited disclosed the transcript of its earnings conference call for the second quarter and first half year ended 30th September 2026, held on 05th November 2026. For H1 FY2027, revenue grew 30% to INR4,319 crores, EBITDA nearly doubled to INR369 crores with an 8.6% margin, and PAT grew more than 4x to INR161 crores. Q2 FY2027 revenue rose 19% to INR1,900 crores, with EBITDA at INR131 crores and PAT at INR40 crores. The company operates 229 stores across 102 cities. Management expects festive season demand to be strong and plans to enter West Bengal with four to five stores by mid-November. Working capital days stood at 61 as of 30th September 2026.

IFBIND.attchmntText: IFB Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
IFBIND.voiceSummary: IFB Industries Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call to BSE and NSE. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue was INR1,512 crores, up 14.04% from INR1,327 crores. PBDIT declined 11.3% to INR90.92 crores due to higher material costs and adverse forex impacts. PBT was INR53.86 crores, and PAT was INR39.56 crores. Year-to-date revenue stood at INR3,042 crores, up 15.34%, with PAT at INR77.62 crores. The Engineering division reported growth driven by fine blanking and stamping, with a business mix of 50% two-wheelers, 40% four-wheelers, and 10% electrical and three-wheelers. A new EV manufacturing facility in Gujarat is under construction, expected to commence operations by September or October 2027. The Steel division increased annealing capacity to 2,800 tons per month, with a customer base split 60% internal and 40% external.

MMTC.attchmntText: MMTC Limited has informed the Exchange about Change in Company Secretary/Compliance Officer
MMTC.voiceSummary: MMTC Limited intimates the change in its Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. Shri Ajay Kumar Misra ceased to hold the position effective 10.11.2026 due to succession planning. The Board of Directors approved the appointment of Ms. Rashmi Chaddha as the new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective 10.11.2026. Ms. Chaddha is an Associate Member of The Institute of Company Secretaries of India with Membership Number A82319. She currently serves as Senior Manager Finance at MMTC Limited. She holds a Bachelor in Commerce Honours degree and has over 17 years of experience in finance and accounts. She is also a member of The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

MMTC.attchmntText: MMTC Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
MMTC.voiceSummary: MMTC Limited announced the Board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 10th November 2026. The independent auditor issued a qualified conclusion on the standalone results. The qualification relates to the Anglo Coal matter. The company estimates a remaining liability of Rs. 170.58 crore. A provision of Rs. 87.76 crore is recorded. The remaining Rs. 82.82 crore is treated as a contingent liability. The auditor noted a departure from Indian Accounting Standard 37. The Audit Committee could not review the results due to non-appointment of Independent Directors. The Board approved the statement without Audit Committee review. The company reported a profit before tax of Rs. 10.96 crore for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.
